tasks.short: Communicate with students who use an alternative method of communications, using sign language or computer technology.

steps.what: Read the posted alternative method card before this session.
Draft the communications symbol for the posted word.
Accept that symbol line, or set it aside.
Commit the accepted symbol line on this job.
Communicate with students using sign language or computer technology.

tasks.design: The speech-language pathologist reads a posted method card on {DOCS}, a fixed board drafts one communications symbol line, and the pathologist accepts that line or sets it aside. A separate step commits only the accepted line on {DOCS}. The pathologist still communicates with the student in the room, and nothing sends a message outside the organisation, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The word and the method sat in the teacher's head, so a symbol could not be looked up from a card.
tasks.enabler_now: A posted card with a method and a word lets a fixed board draft one symbol line for the pathologist to accept.
tasks.still_hard: The student may use a sign or a device in a way the card did not name, and harm comes from a wrong symbol in the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: Only the pathologist in the room can see whether the student is using the symbol.
tasks.altitude: The conversation stays the week. The pathologist gains a symbol line only when the card is complete, and still decides whether to use it.

reach.task: Post the method and the word when the lesson is set.
reach.learn: A blank method is not a method, and the pathologist still leads the conversation.

evidence.claim: A fixed board can pair a posted word with one symbol. The pathologist still chooses whether to use it and still communicates with the student. Model knowledge.
A solely automated care decision needs an Article 22 basis. This line is about the student and is stored only after the pathologist accepts it.
A patient chatbot must disclose that it is AI from 2 August 2026. This design is not a chatbot and does not speak to the student for the pathologist.
Recording that can check staff performance needs works-council consent. This design does not record the session.

assumptions: This task is the session. It starts when the method card is posted and ends when the pathologist has communicated with the student. Setting the lesson is the classroom teacher's work.

The method card has three fields: student, method (sign language or device), and word. The classroom teacher produces it when the lesson is set, and that posting time stays on the teacher. A blank method or a blank word is not a usable card.

If the card is missing or free text, the read is not shorter and the draft and the commit do not run. A line set aside is not committed. The draft is not stored as the student's line. The commit stores only the accepted line, and it is its own step. The pathologist still communicates with the student. That in-room talk is not a send, so the authority is write_internal. Nothing sends a message outside the organisation, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. The design does not write the student's device and does not record the session. Existing document-store runtime is not human effort.
unknowns: Whether this school's device accepts a structured symbol line or only a tap by hand. The design does not write the device.
research_questions: How often is the method card posted with a method and a word rather than free text?

already_counted.description: Reading the method card, including a missing card, stays inside the read.
Accepting or setting aside the symbol line stays inside that step.
Communicating with the student stays inside that step.

incremental.description: When a symbol on the board is renamed, the pathologist checks that the word list still matches the posted words.

approvals.approved_version: the symbol line drafted for this word
the symbol line the speech-language pathologist accepted for this student

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is zero when the method card is missing, so the read is not shorter and the draft and the commit do not run. High is the case where about half the cards are free text, so those two machine steps do not run on that half, and the pathologist still communicates with every student. The high is not a consult-minute figure.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct or direct research on speech or hearing topics and report findings for use in developing procedures, technologies, or treatments.

steps.what: Read the posted research card before this study.
Conduct or direct research on speech or hearing topics.
Draft the findings line from the posted result.
Accept that findings line, or set it aside.
Commit the accepted findings line for this study.
Report findings for developing procedures, technologies or treatments.

tasks.design: The speech-language pathologist reads a posted research card on {DOCS} and still conducts the research in the room. A fixed board drafts a findings line that copies the posted topic, measure and result number, the pathologist accepts that line or sets it aside, and a separate step commits only the accepted line. The pathologist still reports the findings to a clinical colleague in the room, and nothing sends the line outside the organisation, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The result lived in notes, so a findings line could not be copied from agreed fields.
tasks.enabler_now: A posted topic, measure and result number can be copied into a line the pathologist accepts before it is stored.
tasks.still_hard: What the result means for a procedure is a judgement, and a wrong line could be reused in treatment.
tasks.human_edge: The pathologist who ran the study is the one who can say the number is the result.
tasks.altitude: The study stays the week. The pathologist still accepts the line, and still reports it in the room.

reach.task: Post the topic, the measure and the due date when the study is approved.
reach.learn: The findings line lists the posted result and does not replace the study.

evidence.claim: A findings line can list a posted topic, a measure and a result number without interpreting them. The pathologist still conducts the research and still accepts the line. Model knowledge.
A solely automated care decision needs an Article 22 basis. The findings line is stored only after the pathologist accepts it.
The treatment dossier is kept twenty years after the last change. This findings line is for procedure work and is not a change to that dossier.
The provider remains responsible for careful use of generative tools and must know whether a tool is a medical device. This line copies posted fields and does not draft a treatment.

assumptions: This task starts when the research card is posted and ends when the pathologist has reported the findings. Approving the study is the clinical lead's work.

The research card has four fields: topic, measure (speech or hearing), result number, and due date. The clinical lead posts the topic, the measure and the due date when the study is approved. The pathologist writes the result number during the research step, which stays at full time. A blank measure or a blank result number means the line is not drafted and not committed.

If the card is missing or free text, the read is not shorter and the draft and the commit do not run. A line set aside is not committed. The draft copies the posted topic, measure and result number and does not interpret them. The commit stores only the accepted line, and it is its own step, separate from the verbal report. Reporting in the room is a talk with colleagues, so the authority is write_internal. Nothing sends the line to a journal, a patient, or a company outside. Nothing raises an alert or fills a sheet. The line does not log output per colleague. Existing document-store runtime is not human effort.
unknowns: Whether findings for procedure work are stored apart from the patient dossier.
research_questions: How often is the result number posted as a number before the findings line is written?

already_counted.description: Reading the research card, including a missing card, stays inside the read.
Conducting or directing the research stays inside that step.
Accepting or setting aside the findings line stays inside that step.
Reporting the findings in the room stays inside that step.

incremental.description: When a measure name changes, the pathologist checks that the findings field list still names speech or hearing.

approvals.approved_version: the findings line drafted from the posted topic, measure and result number
the findings line the speech-language pathologist accepted for this study

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is zero when the research card is missing, so the read is not shorter and the draft and the commit do not run. High is the case where about half the cards are free text, so those two machine steps do not run on that half, and the pathologist still conducts the research and still reports the findings. The high is not a consult-minute figure.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still the student and the study. Less time goes to hunting a symbol or retyping a findings line. The pathologist still communicates in the room, conducts the research, and accepts a line before it is stored.
reach: A symbol line is committed only after the pathologist accepts it, and the pathologist still communicates with the student.
Research is still conducted in the room, and the findings line does not interpret the result.
A findings line is stored only after acceptance, and nothing is sent outside the organisation.
skills_to_grow: Reject a symbol the student on the day does not use.
Refuse a findings line that the posted result does not match.
Refuse a record that scores a colleague's research output.
role.ambitious_version: The cards are already posted. The pathologist still communicates with the student, conducts the research, and accepts the line before it is stored.
